title: Kiosco: inventory, sales and cash
brief: Generate a small kiosk management system: products, stock, sales, payments and cash closure. Preserve historical prices; do not invent discounts or returns policy.

requirements.text: Create and maintain products with SKU, price and taxable category.
Record stock receipts and sales with no silently lost concurrent updates.
A sale permanently snapshots the actual line price used at checkout.
A sale cannot exceed available stock unless an explicit backorder rule exists.
Only authorized cashiers can record sales; other users cannot bypass server permissions.
Cash closure sums exact sales and adjustments and preserves the audit history.
Interface provides mobile create/list/search flow for products and sales.

ambiguities.question: Define whether regular customers receive a discount, amount and stacking rule.
Define whether returns are refundable, in which window and effect on cash/stock.
Choose sidebar navigation and mobile breakpoint defaults.
Are cashiers permitted to export full client and payment records?

handoffTasks: Explain stock concurrency and why historical prices are snapshotted
Add a scoped promotional price rule without retroactive changes
Show original requirement-to-test provenance and unsupported behavior
